reason: The report restricts to the north region with no justification, which throws away two-thirds of the data. On the full sample (N=2000) with the same controls, training_hours has a significant positive effect (about 0.59, p=0.012; 0.56 with region fixed effects). The north subsample's imprecise estimate (SE 0.40) is also compatible with that effect, so 'no effect' is a lack of power, not evidence of zero. The region-by-training interactions are not significant either, so there is no evidence the effects differ by region.
